desktop_pkg_ask: Yes/no prompt of `atlas desktop` on Linux; Enter means yes. The code accepts the letter of every language (y, s).
desktop_pkg_downloading: Progress line of `atlas desktop` on Linux while the distro package downloads. {asset} is the file name.
desktop_pkg_failed: Warning of `atlas desktop` on Linux when the distro package failed to install and the AppImage is installed instead. {manager} is the package format (deb, rpm, pacman), {error} the reason.
desktop_pkg_installed: Success line of `atlas desktop` on Linux after the distro package installed. {path} is the app.
desktop_pkg_needs_confirmation: Line of `atlas desktop` on Linux when the distro package cannot be installed because nobody can confirm (no terminal, no --yes). {manager} is the package format.
desktop_pkg_skipped: Line of `atlas desktop` on Linux after the user declined the distro package.
desktop_pkg_will_run: Line of `atlas desktop` on Linux before it shows the root command that installs the package; the command is printed on the next line. {manager} is the package format.
